cards.summary: Sheets of white paper containing handwritten ink text and printed text.
cards.typed_words:
(207) 284-9816

Never be afraid when your opinion is based on 
Let s omeone know that their own decision fact 
Every day I become a little bit stronger to not be told how to act
Every day my story gets to be a little longer
And i'm not afraid of that
---
Jensen 2

wouldn't pay us hardly nothing. There wasn't anything like a player's union for us 
to complain to. It was work or don't work. That damn reserve clause made us 
slaves on the cotton field diamond. Cominsky promised us a big bonus for 
winning the pennant and when we won he gave us some lousy champagne. Hell, 
he even charged us for cleaning our uniforms.

The year of the Series, more people were watching baseball than ever. 
After the war it became the talk of the town. The economy recovered and 
everyone had more leisure time. People were so damn interested in baseball 
that they added a couple of games to the Series. There was a lot more people in 
the crowd and there were more gamblers too and they kept trying to get their 
hands on us ballplayers and I heard of times where the gamblers were offering 
more money than we could make in a year. I guess it was just a matter of time 
before somebody gave in. The first I heard about the scandal was before the first 
game. Gandil was the brains of it. He offered me 10 thousand dollars to be part 
of the fix. I refused him then and again when he upped it to 20 thousand. After 
we lost the first two games I knew the fix was on. We won the third game but 
then lost the fourth. After the fourth game, Lefty Williams brought 5 thousand 
dollars to my room. I was never in the inner circle of the guys in on it, though. 
We lost the fifth game and ended up losing the series.

cards.name_on_card: And though I get my A's
cards.item_type: NO HOME IN THE TREE YET · LYRIC QUATRAIN WITH HEMINGWAY ESSAY
cards.summary: A piece of lined notebook paper with handwritten text in black ink.
cards.typed_words:
And though I get my A's
I really pay my dues
With everything I gain
There's still something that I lose

"Luz stayed on duty for threemonths. They were glad
to let her. When they operated on him she prepared him
for the operating table; and they had a joke about
friend or enema" - A very Short Story.

-That's Hemingway... You're not reading
this - you're there. Your mind doesn't have
to stop and process every word it just
sinks in naturally. Hemingway is nice
because he gives you lots of breaks from
reading with his short and choppy
sentences. He knows people's attention spans
are short and I believe he predicted
television, DVDS, computers and the like would
do serious damage to people's minds
so he was wise enough to know that
to reach the children of the future he had
to make his sentences a heckuva
lot shorter than this one is. I also
believe that he would have punched
Mr. Melville right in the head, too.
Papa is plain (in his delivery) but the subject
is always pretty good and sometimes you
even get enema jokes... bonus!

Talent Agents have strong relationships with the various people who bring talent into clubs. Also work with tour promoters.

300 mile radius
